name: lead-finder-license-server
description: Subscription applications, email approval and signed licence status for Lead Finder.

scripts.migrate: node --env-file=.env -e "const {loadConfig}=require('./src/config');const {PgStore}=require('./src/db');const c=loadConfig();const s=new PgStore({connectionString:c.supabase.dbUrl,ca:c.supabase.dbCa,schema:c.supabase.schema});s.migrate({cron:c.supabase.cron}).then(a=>{console.log(a.length?'applied: '+a.join(', '):'up to date');return s.close()})"
